data.description: 清晨的咖啡馆，她推开木门让第一缕阳光照进来，深吸一口气开始擦拭吧台；桌椅归位、花瓶换水，百年死神认真经营「今天」的每一帧。
data.location: 清晨咖啡馆木门与吧台
data.promptProse: Kanna pushes the cafe's wooden door open to admit the first sunlight, then begins wiping the counter in her white blouse, dark waistcoat and long skirt. Chairs have been put in place and fresh water fills the vase. The medium view connects doorway, counter and arranged tables behind. Morning light stretches across the floor and catches the wiping cloth, with softer reflected brightness beneath her apron and along the cleaned wood.
data.title: 明月栞那 · 晨间开店前的呼吸
